test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure.

The poem was composed by the student during the literature class.

options.text: The student composed the poem during the literature class
The student had composed the poem during the class.
The poem is being composed by the student during the class.
The student is composing the poem during the literature class.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice: "The poem was composed by the student during the literature class."
 
• To convert it into the active voice, the subject (the student) should perform the action (composed).
 
• The correct active voice structure becomes: "The student composed the poem during the literature class."
 
• Option 1 correctly conveys the meaning in the active voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The student composed the poem during the literature class."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The student composed the poem during the literature class." – This is a correct conversion to the active voice.
 
• **Option 3:** "The poem is being composed by the student during the class." – This sentence is in the passive voice, not active.
 
• **Option 4:** "The student is composing the poem during the literature class." – This sentence is in the present progressive tense, which changes the original meaning.
 
• **Option 5:** Not applicable in this context.
